Title: Azure Container Instances on Windows and Linux

Body.Content:
Azure Container Instances offers an on-demand compute service delivering rapid deployment of containers with no virtual machine management and elastic cloud scale. We've also lowered the price, making it even more cost-effective to deploy a single container in the cloud.

Learn More
